description: Create and publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and access insights on Meta's Threads platform.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow yielding short-lived user access tokens that can be exchanged for long-lived tokens.
credential_notes: Developers can create a Meta app for free via the Meta App Dashboard and select the Threads use case.
api_notes: Covers posting, media retrieval, profile access, reply management, insights, and webhooks via the Threads Graph API.
mcp_notes: No official vendor-published MCP server found; community MCP servers may exist separately.
rationale: While credentials are self-serve and free, publishing/interacting with external user accounts beyond added test users requires App Review and app publication.

evidence.note: Describes OAuth 2.0 user access tokens, short-lived and long-lived tokens, and the Authorization Window.
Explains creating a Meta app with the Threads use case and adding Threads testers.
Outlines endpoints for posts, profiles, replies, insights, webhooks, and oEmbed.
